description: A pair of black sunglasses lies on the surface next to a small cream-colored folding glasses case. The left hand slides toward the sunglasses while the right hand reaches in from the right, and the right hand lifts and folds the sunglasses as the left hand steadies them, making the sunglasses a two-hand object; then the left hand opens the case and holds it in place as the right hand lowers the folded sunglasses into the case, after which both hands fold the case closed and secure the clasp.
